description.en: Retain entire original lungfish target. Correct inaccurate provisional continuous rear-fin wording: small separate first dorsal, greatly enlarged long-based second dorsal, separate small anal and caudal fins. No modern fused dorsal-tail-anal ribbon.
description.zh: 原创低多边形研究；形态、尺度及不确定性严格以本次已核参考为界。原始限定：Retain entire original lungfish target. Correct inaccurate provisional continuous rear-fin wording: small separate first dorsal, greatly enlarged long-based second dorsal, separate small anal and caudal fins. forbidden: Modern lungfish merged fin margin or symmetric round tail
Turn whole animal into slab, skeleton or partial fish
Use Scaumenacia or adjacent Fig13 taxon proportions
Claim width, coloration or fin pose as measured fossil traits
Labels, plinth, environment or concept-image generation
